scenarios.title: Woreda registrar: legal refusal gates at intake

steps.action: Attempt to file a contract with a one-year lease term

steps.action: Attempt to file a contract with a three-month advance payment
steps.expected: Refused citing Proc. Art. 12 (two-month cap)
steps.observed: Three-month advance: refused — [Proc. Art. 12] Advance payment cannot exceed 2 months' rent.

steps.action: Attempt to certify a PRESENTED file before the nine-point checklist
steps.expected: Refused citing Dir. Art. 9
steps.observed: Certification before the nine-point checklist: refused — [Dir. Art. 9] Certification requires the nine-point checklist fully passed.

steps.action: Stamper officer attempts the registrar's certification act

steps.observed: Stamper STF-0002 refused with 403: Role WOREDA_STAMPER (STF-0002) is not authorized for capability registration:certify. Allowed roles: WOREDA_REGISTRAR.
